items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I remember a thrilling time going into Kelly's stables... Coleman Hawkins walks up to the bandstand... And he starts playing. And they didn't bother us.

ctx.x: Kids, it seems amazing now, but I remember a thrilling time going into Kelly's stables and sitting at a front table, right in front of the bandstand. And the band was playing and Coleman Hawkins walks up to the bandstand and picks up the tenor and one of the fellows in the band says, what do you want to play, Hawk? And he says, body, one, two. And he starts playing. And they didn't bother us.
Any other places you remember hearing in those days around New York? I was there off and on all through those years too.
